answer: The agent walks 4 million pseudo-random cache lines across 32 GB of dedicated RAM, sealing each step with a hash chained to the one before, and must return the final seal within 90 seconds. The verifier checks the seal against the committed terrace offsets and rejects any gap, because skipping lines breaks the chain. One honest agent traverses one 32 GB array, while ten fakes must traverse 320 GB before the same voyage deadline. A broken seal slashes a 300 USDC bond, repeat offenders freeze for 30 days, and the vine seal remains on-ledger.
